Spiced Waffle Fries
By: Jo Ann
Published: Tuesday, May 11, 2010 - 11:30am

Ingredients




Ingredients:

1 package (22 ounce)  frozen waffle-shaped french fries
1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley
1 teaspoon Italian seasoning
1 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
1 tablespoon to 2  olive oil

Preparation

1 Directions: 2 Cook potatoes according to package directions. 3 In a small bowl, combine parsley, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon oil, adding more oil, if necessary, to make a thin dressing. 4 In a large bowl, place fries, add dressing , tossing gently to coat.
